item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-10-08
item.description: Three institutionally dense placements on the same unsolved institutional object this series' prior forty-seven briefings have been documenting — the institutional identity of Chinese open source across institutional borders — and all three placements this cycle's briefing documents sit at institutional layers this series' prior briefings have not documented at before. (1) The Diplomat's October 2026 essay "China's AI Governance Push and the Race to Shape Global AI Rules" documents the National Data Administration's September 12, 2026 announcement of a forthcoming embodied-AI-data-standards programme chaired by NDA head Liu Liehong with seven digital enterprises (ModelBest, Infinigence AI, X Square Robot) calling for shared public data infrastructure for smart physical machinery and robotics, paired with the May 8, 2026 CAC-plus-MIIT-plus-NDRC Implementation Opinions on the Standardized Application and Innovative Development of Intelligent Agents (enforceable July 15, 2026) as China's first comprehensive national agentic-AI policy framework, paired with the July 15, 2026 Interim Measures for the Administration of Anthropomorphic AI Interaction Services, and paired with the essay's comparative framing of the US's fragmented voluntary-NIST-AI-RMF-plus-state-by-state-fragmentation approach versus China's centralized-systematic-top-down-multiple-regulator-specific-lever approach. (2) Forkast's "The Deployment State: How China Is Building AI Agent Infrastructure While the US Debates Containment" documents the same May 8, 2026 Implementation Opinions as world's first dedicated regulatory framework for AI agents enforceable July 15, 2026, paired with a three-tier decision-authorization model enabling scaling across nineteen priority sectors, paired with Shenzhen's Lobster Ten Measures providing up to ten million yuan per firm in agent-adoption subsidies, paired with CAC-registered generative-AI-services and applications numerical evidence (796 services and 481 applications by February 2026), paired with Deloitte's 67-percent-versus-34-percent China-versus-US industrial AI production-deployment figure, paired with Stanford's 2026 AI Index's 2.7 performance-gap figure, paired with Trump's September 29, 2026 Executive Order 14434 Super Intelligence Force governance framework and Xi Jinping's late-July 2026 directive ordering the PLA to strengthen military application of unmanned intelligent technologies tied to 2027 centenary goals. (3) Crypto Briefing's September 22, 2026 exclusive on DeepSeek's plan to deploy at least 160,000 Huawei Ascend 950DT chips at a new Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia data center expected to draw approximately 1 gigawatt of power starting Q4 2026 or Q1 2027, paired with the follow-on reporting that DeepSeek's CEO Liang Wenfeng revealed the deployment plan in investor discussions and that Huawei has pulled forward the launch of its next-generation Ascend 960DT training chip to Q1 2027 — three quarters ahead of the original schedule — due to unusually high demand from Chinese AI developers, paired with DeepSeek's earlier full-parameter post-training of its V4 Pro model using around 1,000 Ascend 910C chips in June 2026 as the proving ground that justified the much larger commitment, paired with DeepSeek's continued reliance on Nvidia for large-scale frontier pre-training tasks alongside its hardware-stack transition for inference workloads. One perspective, not a verdict.
